mostWorthwhile.text: Using ATP on the assembled cell was most worthwhile because it connected the earlier preparations to two visible cell jobs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the prepared protein builder inside was clear but predictable: the goal and locator already showed where it belonged.

surprise.text: I was interested that the same ATP supply supported both making proteins and moving particles toward the more crowded side of the membrane.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though ATP was a new term whose role became clearer through the respiration result rather than from its name alone.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: assembling the cell and then seeing its parts work together made me curious how the game would build toward tissues and organs.
